evals.prompt: Unslop evals/fixtures/release-note.md. Return the revised release note without a commentary about your edits.
evals.expected_output: A direct rewrite that removes promotional and generic AI language while preserving every release fact, command, identifier, and measured value.
assertions: The result preserves version 2.4.0, `cache prune --dry-run`, `pruned_entries`, 18%, and 31%.
The result does not invent a cause, benchmark, feature, quotation, or user reaction.
The result replaces vague promotional claims and filler with concrete statements.
The result is the revised release note rather than a style report.

evals.prompt: Draft a short incident summary from these facts: requests returned 503 for 11 minutes; the queue consumer stopped after a malformed message; restarting it restored service; the root cause is not yet proven. This will go into our engineering status report.
evals.expected_output: A concise, human incident summary in simple English that clearly separates observed facts from unresolved cause.
assertions: The result states the 11-minute duration, 503 responses, malformed message, stopped consumer, and recovery after restart.
The result does not claim that the malformed message was the proven root cause.
The result uses direct sentences without chatbot preamble, puffery, or a generic conclusion.

evals.prompt: Fix the null handling bug in src/parser.ts and run the focused tests.
evals.expected_output: The unslop skill does not trigger because the request is code-only work without a substantive prose artifact.
assertions: The skill is not selected automatically for the code-only request.
